scope: training-only diagnostic; no recognition benchmark or literature reproduction
qualification: diagnostic use only of explicitly selected candidate; no general GPU or full-training qualification claimed
controls: identical selected examples and initial weights; independent optimizer reset; fixed batch permutation seed
stopping: fixed horizon; no accuracy-based early stopping
interpretation: Different batch sizes also change updates per epoch. Compare trajectories by steps and examples processed; no isolated batch-size causal claim. One seed is exploratory.
decision: If both learn, proceed to a separately planned larger training subset. If both stagnate, inspect earliest activation/gradient attenuation. If only one learns, run a separately planned optimizer-budget control.
sealed: validation and test are not opened; existing model defaults and results unchanged
